﻿[b][size=5]✿ HOW TO INSTALL ✿[/size][/b]
1. Once your mod folder is ready, download and install the Portraiture mod into the mod folder and extract the folder! Then it would look like this:
[i]You can delete the .rar after extracting the file[/i][i]
[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nlVWkVx.png[/img]

2. Download, extract the .rar and place the "Naty-js Anime Portraits - Bachelors" folder in the "Portraits" folder [size=2](Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture-999-1-12-1-alpha-20240304-1709536980\Portraiture\Portraits)[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X7mXc95.png[/img]

﻿3. You enter the game normally and create a farm or enter an existing one to generate the "config.json" file, which is located in the "Portraiture" folder [size=2](Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture-999-1-12-1-alpha- 20240304-1709536980\Portraiture)[/size], the mod may not work without this file!
Then you leave the game (don't play, enter the game and leave)!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sFqRySR.png[/img]


4. Now you can log in and play normally! Inside the game, when talking to each of the bachelors for the first time after installing the mod, you need to click "P" to select the right portrait! You only do this a first time, then the portrait remains selected until the end of the game!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/WkVsdUo.png[/img]


[b][size=5]﻿✿ How to install different versions ✿[/size][/b]

If you want to replace a portrait with another version, like the optional version of the younger Harvey without a mustache ~

﻿1. In the "Naty-js Anime Portraits - Bachelors" folder you place the optional version folder after extract, inside!

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/tR36qI0.png[/img]


2. In the different version folder, you copy or cut the files and paste them into the "Naty-js Anime Portraits - Bachelors" folder.
It will ask you to replace the files, you accept, and that's it!!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PAijrSw.png[/img]
